raw_text: PIB Fact Check: A photograph of a purported Ministry of Defence circular ordering emergency troop mobilization is FAKE. The document uses an outdated MoD letterhead, has incorrect file numbering, and contains typographic errors inconsistent with official communications. The Ministry of Defence has issued no such circular. Citizens are advised not to share unverified documents. #PIBFactCheck #Fake
clean_text: PIB Fact Check confirmed MoD circular ordering emergency troop mobilization is fabricated. Document uses outdated letterhead, incorrect file numbering, and contains typographic errors.
